description: This file defines a class 'SineVoice' that extends 'SawVoice' and overrides the 'createOscillator' method to return a 'SineOscillator', replacing the waveform with a sine wave in a MIDI synthesizer implementation.

classes.name: SineVoice
classes.description: A subclass of SawVoice that replaces the oscillator with a sine wave oscillator.

methods.name: createOscillator
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to create and return a SineOscillator instead of the default SawOscillator.
